name: All-In-One Ladder
description: The All-In-One Ladder is the easy-access integrated Ice Bath Tub, designed with convenience in mind. The built-in safety ladder ensures effortless entry and exit for all users. Enjoy a powerful, hassle-free Cold Plunge experience with the integrated 1HP chiller.
